result.topic_en: A sequence of symbolic algebraic expressions, each attached to a linear factor (x-4), (x-6), (x-10), (x-12), (x-16), (x-19), (x-21), built from letters a–v with primed, double-primed and zero-superscript coefficients, followed by a small triangle sketch with vertices labelled alpha, beta, gamma.
result.transcription:
forma\
Math 21 \hfill [-44 h-] 21 (20)

$(x-4)\begin{cases} c'(c-bc)+c^0(cd-bc)\\ +d'(cd-d)+d''(de-d)\\ +e^0(de-ef)+e''(e-ef)\end{cases}$ $+(e-c)i$

$(x-6)\begin{cases} e'(e-de)+e^0(ef-de)\\ +f'(ef-f)+f''(fg-f)\\ +g'(fg-g)+g''(gh-g)\\ +h'(gh-h)+h''(hi-h)\\ +i^0(hi-ik)+i''(i-ik)\end{cases}$ $+(i-e)i$

$(x-10)\begin{cases} i'(i-hi)+i^0(ik-hi)\\ +k'(ik-k)+k''(kl-k)\\ +l^0(kl-lm)+l''(l-lm)\end{cases}$ $+(l-i)i$

$(x-12)\begin{cases} l'(l-kl)+l^0(lm-kl)\\ +m'(lm-m)+m''(mn-m)\\ +n'(mn-n)+n''(no-n)\\ +o'(no-o)+o''(op-o)\\ +p^0(op-pq)+p''(p-pq)\end{cases}$ $+(p-l)i$

$(x-16)\begin{cases} p'(p-op)+p^0(pq-op)\\ +q'(pq-q)+q''(qr-q)\\ +r'(qr-r)+r''(rs-r)\\ +s^0(rs-st)+s''(s-st)\end{cases}$ $+(s-p)i$

$(x-19)\begin{cases} s'(s-rs)+s^0(st-rs)\\ +t'(st-t)+t''(tu-t)\\ +u^0(tu-uv)+u''(u-uv)\end{cases}$ $+(u-s)i$

$(x-21)\begin{cases} u'(u-tu)+u^0(uv-tu)\\ +v'(uv-v)+v''(va-v)\\ +a'(va-a)+a''(ab-a)\\ +b'(ab-b)+b''(bc-b)\\ +c^0(bc-cd)+c''(c-cd)\end{cases}$ $+(c-u)i$

[sketch of a triangle with vertices labelled $\alpha$, $\beta$, $\gamma$, dotted line from $\gamma$ to side $\alpha\beta$]
